start: A gym member with 6 workouts logged in the last 4 weeks, on Settings > Your data

steps.action: Tap 'Ask an AI about your workouts'
user_sees: Page 'Ask an AI'
'Get advice on your training from an AI app you already use, like ChatGPT or Gemini.'
'MettleUp sends nothing. You choose where the text goes. Your name, phone number and body weight are left out.'
Button 'Share to an AI app' and under it 'The text you will share'
must_not: A spinner that never ends
The member's name, phone number or body weight anywhere in the text

steps.action: Read the text in the card
user_sees: 'My gym workouts from the last 4 weeks (<date> to <date>).'
'6 workouts in 4 weeks, about 1.5 a week.'
One line per exercise with best set, First, Latest and 'Going up.' / 'About the same.' / 'Going down.'
Ends with 'My question: Based on these workouts, what should I change in the next 4 weeks to keep getting stronger?...'
must_not: Warm-up sets counted as best sets
A workout older than 28 days in the text

steps.action: Tap 'Share to an AI app', pick ChatGPT
user_sees: The phone's share sheet, then ChatGPT with the text pasted
must_not: MettleUp sending the text to any server itself
The share sheet opening twice

start: A gym member with 6 workouts logged in the last 4 weeks, on Settings > Your data; the member wants to paste it by hand

steps.action: Open 'Ask an AI', long-press the text in the card
user_sees: The text can be selected and copied
must_not: The text not selectable

user_sees: The same text as shown, ending with the question
must_not: A cut or different text from what the card showed

start: A gym member with no workout in the last 28 days (new, or back after a break)

steps.action: Open Settings > Your data > 'Ask an AI about your workouts'
user_sees: The intro words, then 'No workouts in the last 4 weeks' and 'Log a workout, then come back here to ask an AI about it.'
must_not: The 'Share to an AI app' button shown with nothing to share
Older workouts silently used

start: A gym member with 6 workouts logged in the last 4 weeks, on Settings > Your data; the phone cannot open its share sheet

user_sees: Message 'Couldn’t open sharing' and 'Please try again.'
must_not: A crash
Nothing happening with no word

start: A gym member whose workout database cannot be read (read error)

user_sees: 'Couldn't read your workouts' and 'Please go back and open this page again.'
must_not: An empty page with no message
'No workouts in the last 4 weeks' shown for a read failure

start: A gym member with 6 workouts logged in the last 4 weeks, on Settings > Your data, the Ask an AI page already seen once

steps.action: Go back, log and finish a new workout today, open 'Ask an AI' again
user_sees: '7 workouts in 4 weeks' and today's exercises in the lines
must_not: The old text kept from the first visit

steps.action: Delete that workout from History, open 'Ask an AI' again
user_sees: '6 workouts in 4 weeks' again
must_not: The deleted workout still in the text

start: A gym member with 6 workouts logged in the last 4 weeks, on Settings > Your data, body weight logged on Profile, phone number linked to the gym

steps.action: Open 'Ask an AI' and read the whole text
user_sees: Only exercises, sets, dates and muscle names
must_not: The member's name, phone number, gym name or body weight
A kg-lifted total that body weight could be worked out from

user_sees: Only the share sheet; the member picks the app
must_not: Any network call by MettleUp carrying the text

note: 15 exercises at most, then 'And N more exercises, done less often.'; '1 workout' must be singular
The window is today minus 27 days by the saved workout date; a workout on day 28 must be in, day 29 out
Share uses a busy guard; a second fast tap must not open two share sheets
Text is re-read when units change; the text itself is only in English
Long text in a card on a settings page must scroll
Old workouts with no duration or distance fields must still give best sets
A workout logged from the watch must appear in the text once on the phone

start: A gym member with 12 finished workouts, 3 records and body weight logged, on Profile

user_sees: Screen 'Badges' with subtitle like '3 of 16 earned'
'You earn badges from the workouts you log in the app. Each badge is earned once, on the day of the workout that earned it.'
must_not: A count that does not match the rows shown
A skeleton that never goes away

user_sees: 'First workout', '10 workouts', 'First record' bright, newest first, each with 'Earned <date>'
must_not: An earned badge dated on a day with no workout
The same badge twice

user_sees: Dim rows with how to earn, e.g. 'Finish 50 workouts.' and '12 of 50 workouts'
must_not: Progress above the goal on a badge not earned
An earned badge also listed here

start: A gym member about to finish a workout that started at 6:15 in the morning, their 5th early start

user_sees: Finish screen line 'New badge: Early bird'
must_not: Workout-count badges named in this line (the milestone line says them)
The line on a workout that earned nothing

user_sees: 'Early bird' under 'Earned' with today's date
must_not: 'Early bird' still under 'Still to earn'

start: A new gym member with no workout logged yet

user_sees: '0 of 16 earned'
No 'Earned' heading; every badge under 'Still to earn' with its how-to line and no '0 of ...' progress line
must_not: An error or empty screen
A badge shown as earned

start: A gym member who benched 80 kg on a barbell but never logged body weight, and did assisted pull-ups with 110 kg help

user_sees: 'Bench your body weight' under 'Still to earn' with 'Log your body weight on your Profile, under Body, so the app can check.'
'100 kg on the bar' not earned from the assisted pull-up
must_not: The bench badge earned with no body weight to compare
Help weight on an assisted lift counted as load

start: A gym member whose workout database cannot be read

user_sees: A load error about 'your badges' with a retry button
must_not: An empty shelf that looks like no badges earned

start: A gym member whose only workout over 100 kg on the bar earned the badge yesterday

user_sees: '100 kg on the bar' under 'Earned', 'Earned <yesterday>'
must_not: Two dates for one badge

steps.action: Delete that workout from History, come back to 'Badges'
user_sees: '100 kg on the bar' back under 'Still to earn' with 'Your heaviest so far: <kg>'
must_not: The badge still earned from a deleted workout
An old cached shelf after the delete

start: A gym member with 12 finished workouts, 3 records and body weight logged, on Profile at 72 kg, bench best 75 kg

user_sees: The badge name and earned date only
must_not: The member's body weight figure shown on the shelf

user_sees: Badges are worked out on this phone from its own workouts
must_not: Badges sent to the gym or shown to other members

note: 500 workouts badge: the shelf reads every workout, so a big history must still open fast
Weeks in a row depends on the week start; Early bird uses the phone's own clock hour, so a changed time zone can earn or lose it

why_not: read-only shelf: nothing is typed or saved here; the finish-screen line is read after the workout is already saved

note: Names change with units ('100 kg on the bar' in lb)
Long how-to lines must wrap beside the medal
Workouts saved before badges existed must earn badges on their own dates
A workout logged on the watch must count toward badges
